name: Pomodoro
author: Wilbur Lindqvist (techywilbur)
description: Pomodoro focus timer for the Omarchy bar: a countdown in the bar, a popup with transport controls, focus presets and break buttons, a desktop notification and chime when a block ends, Do Not Disturb while you focus, daily stats, and an optional full-screen break screen. Survives shell restarts and suspend.

barWidget.description: Focus timer with notifications, a chime and DND during focus

schema.label: Long break after every N focus blocks
schema.description: 0 disables long breaks and the session dots.

schema.label: Silence notifications while focusing
schema.description: Turns on Do Not Disturb for the length of a focus block and restores the previous state afterwards.

schema.label: Full-screen break screen (optional)
schema.description: Off by default: a break is a desktop notification and a chime. Turn on to also cover every monitor with a break screen during breaks. Esc hides it, Space skips the break.

schema.label: Chime at the end of a block
Desktop notification at the end of a block
Start the break automatically when focus ends
Start the next focus automatically when a break ends
schema.description: Off: wait for you to press Start (or Enter on the break screen).

schema.label: Pause a focus block when you are idle
schema.description: Pauses a running focus block after the idle time below and resumes it when you are back. Only a pause made this way resumes by itself; breaks are never paused.

schema.label: Idle minutes before a focus block pauses
Drop a restored timer if it ended more than N minutes ago
